method.horizon: 20 trading days, excess return versus SPY, direction adjusted
method.point_in_time: memos before the decision date, outcomes knowable before it

headline: Of 218 calls where the memory had evidence, the 73 it supported hit 32% with -5.0% average excess, and the 145 it warned against hit 45% with -3.2% average excess.
sensitivity_summary: Across retrieval depths 5 to 12, calls the memory supported were right 32% to 41% of the time and calls it warned against 40% to 45%. In no setting did following the memory clearly beat ignoring it.
